(defprotocol NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x]))
(extend-type java.lang.Long NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :long))
(extend-type java.lang.Double NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :double))
(extend-type clojure.lang.BigInt NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :bigint))
(extend-type java.math.BigInteger NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :biginteger))
(extend-type clojure.lang.Ratio NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :ratio))
(defprotocol NumericBaseProtocol (numeric-base [x]))
(extend-type java.lang.Number NumericBaseProtocol (numeric-base [x] :number))
(extend-type java.lang.Long NumericBaseProtocol (numeric-base [x] :long))

(prn (mapv numeric-base [1 1.0 1N (biginteger 1) 1/2 2 2.0 2N]))
(prn [(satisfies? NumericBaseProtocol 1) (satisfies? NumericBaseProtocol 1.0) (satisfies? NumericBaseProtocol 1N) (satisfies? NumericBaseProtocol (biginteger 1)) (satisfies? NumericBaseProtocol 1/3) (satisfies? NumericBaseProtocol nil)])
